concerns.text: T018 (Implement QIIME2 pipeline) is marked [X] (complete) but depends on T014 (unified_sample_table.csv) which is marked [ ] (incomplete). The task description explicitly states 'depends on T014'. A consumer task (T018) cannot be marked complete before its producer (T014) is complete. This violates the producer-before-consumer ordering rule.

The dependency chain T014 -> T018 -> T019 -> T020 is broken by the status of T014. T014 must precede T018.

T029 (Compute Bray-Curtis) depends on T019 (Rarefied OTU table). T019 is marked [X] but T018 (which generates the OTU table) is marked [X] while T014 (input to T018) is [ ]. The data flow is broken: T014 (unified table) -> T018 (OTU table) -> T019 (Rarefied) -> T029. T014 must be completed before T018 can be considered valid.

T022b (Fallback logic for LME) is marked [ ] (incomplete) but is a critical part of FR-003 (System MUST fallback if sites < 2). The task is listed after T022a (LME function) which is marked [X]. However, T022b is a logical dependency for the robustness of T022a. If T022a is implemented without T022b, the system fails the spec requirement. The ordering implies T022a is 'done' while the fallback is 'pending', which is a semantic violation of the 'complete story' requirement.

This creates a false state of 'complete' for US2 and US3 before US1 is fully functional.
